set.property_comment: Duration line under each period: '(from RND until End of Treatment visit [EOT], 26 to 52 weeks)' spanning Visits 2-12, the 'Early termination (ET)' sub-band over Visit 12a, and '(14 days after EOT or ET)' printed as the second part of the Safety Follow-up cell. The label column prints it as '(Duration)' under 'Study periods': a qualifier of the periods row, so typed 'other' with no hierarchical level. 'Early termination' sits in this row for space; Visit 12a is told apart by its visit number (decision D1).

corrections.reason: The printed label '(Duration)' under 'Study periods' presents the row as a qualifier of the periods, not a level of its own. A level would group Visits 2-12 against 12a as if Early termination were a sub-period; it is a conditional visit, already told apart by Visit number 12a. Prompt §4: a row whose values follow from another header row does not tell columns apart.
Companion to corr-001: with the Duration row at no level, Visit number moves from level 3 to 2 (levels stay consecutive, prompt §4).

One ruled header row with two printed lines per cell; kept as one row with both lines in the cell value. Splitting it into a week row and a study-day row is interpretation, left to consumers (Layers 1-3 transcribe).

corrections.reason: Site / phone is an attribute of each visit, not a grouping; every column is already told apart by its visit number. Same reading as NCT05051579's 'Fasting Visit' row (modality, no level).
Companion to corr-001 and corr-004: with the Duration and Visit type rows at no level, the Week / Study day row moves from level 5 to 3 (levels stay consecutive, prompt §4).
